tasks.title: Map literature landscape and dominant baseline families
tasks.description: Survey recent methods, identify dominant design patterns, and cluster representative baselines.

tasks.title: Synthesize unresolved gaps for method innovation
tasks.description: Summarize what current methods miss and where a new method can create measurable value.

tasks.title: Generate research ideas using creative frameworks
tasks.description: Apply SCAMPER and other divergent thinking to produce candidate research ideas.

tasks.title: Evaluate and rank ideas with multi-persona review
tasks.description: Score each idea across novelty, feasibility, impact, and clarity.

tasks.title: Collect reference code and datasets
tasks.description: Find reference implementations, download relevant datasets, build resource manifest.

tasks.title: Survey reference implementations
tasks.description: Clone and analyze reference repos to map paper concepts to code locations.

tasks.title: Implement experiment code
tasks.description: Write the core experiment code following the plan-implement-judge loop.

tasks.title: Analyze experiment results
tasks.description: Aggregate multi-seed runs, perform significance testing, generate tables and figures.

tasks.title: Draft the paper
tasks.description: Write the paper section by section with venue-specific formatting.

tasks.title: Generate paper figures
tasks.description: Create paper-quality figures: conceptual diagrams and data plots.

tasks.title: Simulated peer review
tasks.description: Three-reviewer simulation: novelty, methodology, clarity. Iterate until no fatal issues.

tasks.title: Audit all citations
tasks.description: Verify every reference exists, check cited claims, flag fabricated references.

tasks.description: Generate academic slide deck with narration scripts.
